verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs explicitly claim built-in package registry support for 20+ formats (Cargo, npm, Maven, PyPI, NuGet, Docker/Container, Helm, RubyGems, Composer, Conda, etc.) directly from the same platform used for git hosting, matching the story's requirement to publish and consume packages in multiple formats. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on community evidence corroborating package registry usage or reliability, and no detail on per-format quirks or limitations.
